name: NeuTex Initialization Training Procedure
definition: A pre-training stage to initialize the inverse texture mapping network $F_{uv}^{-1}$ and texture mapping network $F_{uv}$ using a downsampled point cloud and uniformly sampled UV coordinates on a unit sphere.
summary: NeuTex Initialization Training Procedure pre-trains texture mapping networks by aligning 3D geometry with sparse point clouds and enforcing UV-to-3D consistency via Chamfer and cycle losses, unlike standard NeRF methods.
